meta.task: Design a battery for extreme-cold environment equipment: 1C discharge capacity retention >= 95% at -20C, energy density >= 327.18 Wh/kg, volumetric energy density >= 880 Wh/L.
meta.start_stage_reason: task text names no new materials/additives/electrode chemistry; objective decomposes to architecture/formulation parameters and electrolyte transport overrides -> Stage 3 (rule: only architecture/formulation -> start_stage 3)
meta.base_reason: task text names no electrode system -> anchor-table default Chen2020 (recorded per protocol; funnel log carries discriminant verification)
meta.freedoms_basis: task text declares no locks -> widest interpretation with record (t1_r1 lesson)
meta.retention_definition: retention_1c_m20c = capacity_ah(lowT_discharge, 253.15 K, 1C) / capacity_ah(1C_discharge, 298.15 K, 1C), identical params; derived file written mechanically from the two tool outputs
meta.energy_density_basis: calc-energy contract caliber on 298.15 K 1C discharge; electrolyte excluded from mass/volume (electrolyte_included:false)
meta.safety_defaults: task text silent on safety; defaults chosen and recorded: T_max_K <= 333.15 K and plated=false on 4C_charge_45C (lumped thermal + plating); overcharge/nail-penetration not in task scope
meta.durability: not requested (cycle life/SEI not in task text) -> aging protocol not in scope

objective_breakdown: three stage2 cell metrics + two default stage3 safety metrics; binding constraints expected W3 (energy_density_wh_l>=880, layers-only contract) and W1 (retention_1c_m20c>=0.95) which conflict (dense thick stack vs cold 1C transport); W2 (>=327.18 Wh/kg) moderately conflicts with W1 via separator/collector overhead; implied stack mean density 2.69 g/cm3 is cathode-dominated
candidate_strategy: R1 Chen2020 baseline full profile (1C discharge + calc-energy + lowT discharge + retention + 4C/45C safety) + opening ceiling assessment of best-possible Chen2020 architecture/formulation against the three stage2 targets; R2 in-set tuning (particle radius, thickness/porosity/separator/collector, electrolyte sigma/D/t+ overrides marked estimate); if material gap -> ceiling_escalation to OKane2022 (NMC811/graphite+SiOx, anchor-table match) then 2-4 architecture/formulation variants per round (exploration_force ON); DFN precision + Stage 4 safety on finalists; closing deliverables with real_compute=false skip
budget_allocation: Stage 3 exploration ~60% (baseline+ceiling+<=8 variant rounds), Stage 4 safety ~20%, closing ~20%; SPMe screens all rounds, DFN only passers; per-round pattern propose -> simulations -> calc-energy -> mechanical retention -> batch log-evaluate
risk_and_fallback: R1 cold-vs-Wh/L irreconcilable -> fallback per cause scale (transport -> electrolyte overrides/Stage 2 formulation; areal current -> thinner electrodes), three-strike triggers layered questioning and possibly honest negative result with reachable frontier stated; R2 LCO ceiling gap -> assessed in R1, escalate system not thrash architecture; R3 bridge estimates marked estimate; R4 Chen2020 injected thermal/geometry defaults -> T_max marked approximate; R5 SPMe/DFN cross-check on finalists; R6 artifacts labeled honestly

candidates.name: baseline-Chen2020
candidates.role: baseline characterization: Chen2020 defaults, no overrides (start_stage=3, materials use system baseline)

llm_reason: start_stage=3 (no new materials in task text): first round establishes the full baseline profile across all entry-0 criteria (1C discharge + calc-energy contract ED, lowT discharge with true cold soak, 4C/45C safety with plating) before any variant. Cold-soak measurement procedure: lowT runs use Initial temperature [K]=253.15 so the -20C retention measures a genuinely cold-soaked discharge (the parameter-set default initial temperature 298.15 would mask cold loss - warm-start artifact); 25C reference keeps 298.15. This is a measurement-procedure choice, design params identical; recorded here and in funnel entry.

detail: start_stage=3: this case starts at Stage 3; materials use system baseline (source: baseline literature parameterization). Base determination (anchor table, deterministic): task text names no electrode system -> default Chen2020. Discriminant dump of chosen set: Positive/Negative OCP = nmc_LGM50_ocp_Chen2020 / graphite_LGM50_ocp_Chen2020 (NMC811/graphite, matching 'NMC811/graphite baseline teaching parameterization' anchor); Nominal cell capacity 5.0 Ah; this PyBaMM build's Chen2020 carries a complete thermal block (Cell cooling surface area 0.00531 m2, Cell volume 2.42e-5 m3, collector thicknesses present) so no default injection expected on the thermal keys (dump-verified; anchor-table note 'no complete thermal set' not triggered here). Model cold-behavior observation (recorded honestly): electrolyte conductivity/diffusivity functions are temperature-independent in this set (measured sigma(1000,298)/sigma(1000,253)=1.0, D ratio 1.0); no solid-diffusion activation-energy keys; the only Arrhenius cold channel is interfacial kinetics (anode i0 ~4.5x lower at 253.15 K, cathode ~2.1x) - cold-capacity loss in these sims therefore reflects kinetics only.
ceiling_assessment: Opening ceiling assessment (Chen2020 set): levers assessed: separator 12->8 um (-2.0% stack volume), porosities 0.335/0.25->0.28/0.22 (-2.6% volume), electrode thickening t_pos 75.6->~92 / t_neg 85.2->~112 um (energy +~17% before polarization, volume +~15% - mild net W3 gain ~+2-4%), collector thinning 16/12->12/8 um (-2.0%). Pumped combination estimate: W3 ceiling ~870-890 Wh/L (limited by NMC811/graphite capacity and fixed h/geometry) - gap to 880 is small but real; W2 ceiling >> 400 (already passes); W1 (cold retention) near-free in-model (baseline measured 0.994 with cold soak - kinetics-only model); W5 plating FAILS at baseline (anode saturates at end of 4C charge, min anode potential -0.44 V) and needs N/P restructuring (thicker negative) or transport/kinetics improvement - which costs W3. Conclusion: objective may be reachable in-stage but requires coordinated architecture trade-off; material escalation (OKane2022 SiOx system) held as the fallback if the architecture space stalls below 880 Wh/L.
